profile.title: My profile
profile.noticeBody: You have {count} new university support service consent request awaiting your decision. You retain full agency over which university departments can view specific sections of your record.
profile.privacyStandard: Personal agency privacy standard level 4 applied
profile.milestoneBody: AdviseCare tracks only your own degree requirements and verified institutional events. It never calculates peer comparisons, cohort percentile curves or comparative rankings.
profile.telemetryBody: Cloud IDE and external coding workspace telemetry are not collected or linked to your university profile. Your code keystroke cadence, local repository history and external reading logs remain unmonitored.
profile.agencyRuleBody: Only circumstances you have actively consented to disclose are visible to designated university staff. Unauthorised roles see zero flags and no mention of withheld factors.
profile.ledgerSubtitle: Immutable chronological log of every interaction documented by your faculty advisor.
profile.fileComment: File a comment on this note

consent.title: My consent & privacy permissions
consent.intro: You have complete control over which university roles can view specific parts of your personal circumstances. Each purpose has distinct, granular boundaries. Declining or withdrawing an optional scope never restricts your portal access, enrolment status or academic rights.
consent.agencyBody: Separate purposes are never bundled into a single opt-in. Every permission is evaluated independently. Declining an optional purpose does not disable your account, alter financial aid already granted, or affect your academic standing.
consent.pendingTitle: Action requested: pending faculty request awaiting your decision
consent.requestedAttributes: Independently requested attributes — evaluate each one
consent.guardrail: Institutional guardrail: unconsented medical and clinical records remain omitted and will not be requested.
consent.awaitingAction: Awaiting your affirmative action. No automated grants occur.

scope.title: Review consent scope
scope.intro: You have complete authority over every specific data attribute requested by university departments. Affirmative selection is unbundled: choosing one attribute never obligates you to grant another, and declining never affects your enrolment, advising access or academic standing.
scope.rbacNote: Only officers officially assigned to the active case file can inspect consented attributes.
scope.nonRetaliationBody: Declining this request or individual attributes prevents welfare officers from viewing those records. It never restricts your access to classes, academic advising, portal services, exam registration, facilities or basic entitlements.
scope.matrixSubtitle: Select only the discrete attributes you affirmatively consent to share.
scope.antiBlanketBody: You may grant permission for one attribute while withholding others. Unchecked attributes remain completely withheld with zero downstream transmission.
scope.defaultState: Default state: private & sealed · can be shared later at your sole discretion
scope.summaryBody: If you save now, the Student Welfare Officer receives access only to your housing-support need. Your financial circumstances, medical records and academic notes remain fully withheld and invisible.
scope.immutableNote: Your selection creates an immutable, timestamped cryptographic audit record signed under your session.

withdraw.title: Withdraw financial-circumstances consent
withdraw.valueStatus: Value status: protected · withheld from display
withdraw.noticeBody: Access under this consent will stop. The protected information enters erasure processing. Past advising entries remain, but erased information cannot be reopened.
withdraw.safeguardBody: Staff who previously consulted this attribute lose read access immediately across all systems. The underlying circumstance data is queued for purging in the institutional records pipeline.
withdraw.isolationOk: This attribute has no other active purpose grant.
withdraw.guaranteeBody: Withdrawing consent is distinct from deleting your account or erasing your educational history. You are exercising an unbundled statutory right, and you may re-grant consent at any time.
withdraw.cancelNote: Cancelling preserves your current permissions exactly as they are.

receipt.title: Consent withdrawal & erasure dispatch receipt
receipt.body: Consent grant CONS-001 (academic advising) has been formally revoked. Downstream cryptographic authorisation keys were severed immediately across all faculties.
receipt.enforcementTitle: Enforcement guarantee: zero ingestion & immediate read prohibition
receipt.enforcementBody: No new access is permitted under the withdrawn consent while the erasure job is processed. The Academic Advisor role and all campus advising systems can no longer inspect or query your financial circumstances.
receipt.valueState: Value state: protected · nullified (no value in record)
receipt.ledgerIntegrityBody: Past advising consultation notes remain preserved in the immutable audit ledger, but the confidential financial circumstance specifics are withheld and cannot be reopened.
receipt.irrevocableBody: There is no undo that restores an erased value. Once the purge completes, the raw attribute data cannot be recovered.
receipt.milestoneBody: Erasure verified — automated purge attestation signed by the Data Protection Steward.
receipt.otherScopesBody: Withdrawing this grant strictly preserves every other independent purpose.

access.title: My access history & audit log
access.intro: A complete, immutable chronological record of every institutional query and access attempt made to your student record. Access is granted strictly according to your active consent scopes.
access.zeroHiddenBody: 100% of staff reads, automated syncs and denied attempts are permanently written to this verifiable audit ledger.
access.purposeBoundBody: Staff can only query categories explicitly permitted for their operational role and validated against your current consent grants.
access.instantSeveranceBody: Denied attempts return 0 bytes when consent is absent or revoked, enforced cryptographically at the gateway layer.

correction.title: Request a telemetry or record correction
correction.rightBody: Students have the legal right to challenge institutional telemetry and administrative data. Submitting a request initiates a formal multi-party advisor review and does not overwrite or mutate the historical record. If approved, the correction is recorded as an append-only reconciliation event preserving the complete evidentiary trail.
correction.nonOverwritingBody: Submitting does not alter live profile metrics. Historical telemetry remains untouched until verification completes.
correction.verificationBody: Requests are reviewed by your designated academic advisor and the relevant data stewards.
correction.genericNotificationsBody: System alerts contain zero private payload — only the ticket reference is disclosed.
correction.proposedHint: Replaces the marked absence with certified attendance.
correction.reasonMedical: Excused medical absence with paper slip
correction.statementHint: Entries to this record are indexed into the official university archive. False statements violate the Academic Integrity Charter §9.
correction.attachHint: Max 10 MB · PDF, PNG or TIFF
correction.governanceBody: Submitting this form creates an append-only correction ticket. Your profile attendance remains unchanged until the advisor and Facilities complete verification. No historical telemetry is overwritten.

export.title: Export machine-readable student dossier
export.intro: Generates an authenticated, verifiable JSON package containing your surviving academic ledger, indicator provenance, consent transactions and chronological access trails.
export.compliance: Right to data portability & institutional transparency directive
export.guaranteeBody: Attributes subject to verified erasure are irreversibly purged and transmit exactly 0 payload bytes ("value": null). Tombstone timestamps, ledger blocks and destruction proofs remain permanently bound for audit integrity. No private keys and no third-party student records are ever extracted.
export.componentsCaption: Validated scope of {count} data packages integrated into the payload
export.schema1Body: Canonical enrolment identifiers, bitemporally verified credentials and real-time standing.
export.schema2Body: Deterministic calculation sources, turnstile ingestion and VLE interaction telemetry.
export.schema3Body: Complete cryptographic audit trail of authorisations, revocations and certified nullifications.
export.schema4Body: Immutable case encounters, advisor credentials, append-only corrections and superseding addenda.
export.schema5Body: Unabridged chronological ledger of actor queries, permitted reads and policy enforcement denials.

events.title: Events & workshops
events.architectureBody: Event registration and on-site check-in are purely logistical actions. Attaching event attendance or a verification badge to your formal advising case file requires a separate, opt-in participation consent purpose. Registering for or attending a workshop never shares your data with advisors or welfare staff without distinct authorisation.
events.invariant: Strict invariant: no public leaderboards and no gamification.
events.demoData: Demonstration data: simulated listings and seat tallies.

event.logisticalOnly: Logistical booking only · non-binding to advising
event.fullPolicyBody: When a session reaches maximum capacity, venue fire and health regulations prevent additional admissions. No waitlist queue is maintained for standard workshops; alternate dates are listed on the events page.
event.statutoryRule: Statutory privacy rule: registration and check-in are purely logistical actions. Participation consent is strictly separate and is never bundled automatically with a room reservation.
event.recipientBody: Scoped exclusively to your designated academic guidance case file.
event.expiryBody: Lapses automatically and can be revoked immediately at any time from the consent hub.
event.chooseLevel: Select the consent authorisation level for your advising record
event.optionA: Option A — do not link to the advising record (logistical attendance only)
event.optionABody: Your attendance remains purely logistical for room seating. Your advisor sees no workshop badge.
event.optionB: Option B — share the participation badge with your academic advisor
event.optionBBody: Attaches the official attendance stamp and strategy badge to your advising file. The 180-day lapse policy applies.
event.windowOpenBody: Active check-in window 13:30 – 15:30 ICT (the session starts at 14:00). Scan your pass at the room reader or continue with portal check-in.
event.windowLockedBody: Physical check-in unlocks exactly 30 minutes before the workshop starts.
